title: Grade 7 Term 3 Revision Collection 2026
sourceNote: Original practice material developed using the uploaded assessment as a topic and competency guide. Questions are newly authored and are not copied from the source paper.

subjects.name: Mathematics
mcq: Move the decimal four places to the right: 5.6 × 10⁻⁴.
A school has 468 learners. If 3/4 are present, how many are present?
A rectangle measures 12 cm by 7 cm. Find its perimeter.
structured: A shop buys a school bag for KSh 1,600 and sells it at a profit of 15%. Calculate the selling price.
Profit = 15/100 × 1,600 = KSh 240. Selling price = 1,600 + 240 = KSh 1,840.
A rectangular garden is 18 m long and 11 m wide. Calculate its area and the cost of fencing it at KSh 250 per metre.
Area = 18 × 11 = 198 m². Perimeter = 2(18 + 11) = 58 m. Fencing cost = 58 × 250 = KSh 14,500.

subjects.name: Integrated Science
mcq: Which laboratory apparatus is most suitable for measuring 25 cm³ of a liquid accurately?
A measuring cylinder is designed to measure liquid volumes.
Which process separates an insoluble solid from a liquid?
Filtration traps the insoluble solid on filter paper.
Which part of a light microscope is used to adjust the amount of light?
The mirror or illuminator directs light through the specimen.
Which one is a chemical change?
Rusting forms a new substance, iron oxide.
The main function of the placenta is to:
Exchange materials between mother and foetus
The placenta enables exchange of nutrients, gases and wastes.
structured: Describe how you would separate a mixture of sand, salt and water to obtain dry sand and salt crystals.
Filter the mixture to separate sand. Wash and dry the sand. Heat the filtrate gently to concentrate it, then allow it to cool so salt crystals form; collect and dry the crystals.
State two precautions when using a light microscope and give a reason for each.
Carry it with two hands to prevent dropping. Clean lenses only with lens tissue to avoid scratching them. (Any two well-explained precautions.)

subjects.name: English
mcq: Where are you going asked Amina.
Where are you going? asked Amina
A direct question takes a question mark inside the quotation marks.
The word closest in meaning to 'cautious' is:
Cautious means careful to avoid danger or mistakes.
Choose the correct plural form of 'analysis'.
The plural of analysis is analyses.
Identify the adverb: 'The learner answered the question confidently.'
Confidently describes how the learner answered.
Which expression is an example of personification?
The wind whispered through the trees.
The wind is given the human action of whispering.
structured: Write a formal letter to your school head requesting permission to organise a clean-up activity. Include the purpose, proposed date and materials needed.
Award marks for correct sender/recipient format, date, salutation, clear subject, polite request, relevant details, appropriate closing and accurate language.
Read this short situation: Two friends find a wallet containing money and an identity card. Explain two responsible actions they should take and why.
They should hand it to a teacher or trusted authority and avoid using the money. The identity card can help locate the owner; honesty protects the owner's property.

subjects.name: Kiswahili
mcq: Methali 'Haraka haraka haina baraka' inamaanisha nini?
Kufanya kazi kwa pupa huleta makosa
Methali hii hufundisha kuwa pupa inaweza kusababisha makosa.
Neno 'polepole' ni aina gani ya kielezi?
Katika shairi, mstari mmoja wa ubeti huitwaje?
structured: Andika insha ya aya tatu kuhusu umuhimu wa kutunza mazingira ya shule. Tumia mifano halisi.
Tathmini utangulizi, hoja zinazofaa, mifano kama kupanda miti na kutupa taka mahali panapofaa, mtiririko wa mawazo, sarufi na hitimisho.
Eleza sifa mbili za mhusika mwema katika hadithi na utoe mfano wa kila sifa.
Majibu yanaweza kutaja uaminifu, huruma, bidii, ushirikiano au uwajibikaji; kila sifa iungwe mkono na mfano unaoeleweka.

subjects.name: Pre-Technical Studies
mcq: A drawing instrument used to draw a circle is a:
A compass is used to draw circles and arcs.
The central processing unit executes instructions.
A line drawn to show a hidden edge in technical drawing is usually:
Hidden details are represented using dashed lines.
Which material is a good electrical conductor?
Copper allows electric current to pass through easily.
Which action promotes safe use of digital devices?
Strong passwords help protect accounts and information.
structured: Name three measuring or marking-out tools and state one use for each.
Tape measure—measuring length; try square—checking right angles; pencil/scriber—marking lines; ruler—measuring or drawing straight lines. Any three correct pairs.
State three ways of caring for workshop tools.
Clean and dry after use; store in the correct place; use each tool for its intended purpose; oil moving metal parts where appropriate; report damaged tools.

subjects.name: Creative Arts & Sports
mcq: In music, the symbol that indicates silence is called a:
A rest indicates a period of silence.
Stretching improves the range of movement at joints.
Red, yellow and blue are traditionally classified as:
They are commonly taught as primary colours.
In football, a player uses the inside of the foot mainly to:
The inside of the foot offers control for accurate passing.
A composition showing objects as they appear from one viewpoint uses:
Perspective creates the impression of depth and distance.
structured: Describe two safety measures to observe when practising a javelin throw.
Ensure the throwing area is clear; throw only on the teacher's signal; carry the javelin point-down; retrieve only when instructed; never aim at people.
Explain two ways colour can be used to create emphasis in a poster.
Use a contrasting colour for the main message; use a bright or warm colour on the focal image; limit competing colours so the key information stands out.

subjects.name: Agriculture & Nutrition
mcq: Which practice helps reduce soil erosion on a sloping farm?
Contour farming slows runoff by following the slope's contour lines.
Which tool is most suitable for loosening soil around young seedlings?
A hand fork loosens soil carefully around small plants.
Which method preserves vegetables by removing moisture?
Drying reduces moisture needed for microbial growth.
A balanced diet supplies all essential nutrients in suitable proportions.
Which animal product is obtained from bees?
structured: State three practices that promote hygiene when keeping poultry.
Provide clean drinking water; clean feeders and drinkers; keep the poultry house dry and ventilated; dispose of droppings safely; isolate sick birds.
Explain two reasons for processing harvested honey before packaging it for sale.
To remove wax, dead bees and other impurities; to improve quality and appearance; to reduce contamination and support safe storage.

subjects.name: Christian Religious Education
mcq: According to the creation account in Genesis, human beings were created:
Genesis teaches that human beings were created in God's image.
Which action demonstrates good stewardship of the environment?
Stewardship includes caring responsibly for creation.
Moses received the Ten Commandments at:
The biblical account places the giving of the commandments at Mount Sinai.
Which value is shown by helping a person in need?
The main purpose of prayer is to:
Prayer is a way of communicating with God.
structured: Give three ways learners can demonstrate care for God's creation at school.
Plant and protect trees; conserve water; dispose of waste properly; avoid damaging plants and habitats; participate in environmental clean-ups.
Explain two lessons Christians can learn from the story of the Good Samaritan.
Show compassion to people in need regardless of background; take practical action to help others rather than ignoring suffering.

subjects.name: Islamic Religious Education
mcq: The holy book revealed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is the:
The Qur'an was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
The obligatory daily prayers in Islam are:
Muslims are required to perform five daily prayers.
Zakat supports those in need and purifies wealth.
Muslims observe obligatory fasting during Ramadan.
A person who tells the truth demonstrates:
structured: State three benefits of fasting during Ramadan.
Develops self-discipline; encourages empathy for people who are hungry; strengthens devotion to Allah; promotes patience and gratitude. Any three.
Explain two ways Muslims can promote peaceful coexistence in their community.
Respect neighbours and people of other backgrounds; resolve disagreements peacefully; help those in need; avoid insults and discrimination.

subjects.name: Social Studies
mcq: A map key is used to:
A key explains the meaning of symbols used on a map.
Which is a physical feature of the environment?
A mountain is a natural landform.
The main purpose of a constitution is to:
Provide the framework for governing a country
A constitution establishes government structures, powers and rights.
Washing one item at a time under a running tap
Repairing leaks prevents unnecessary water loss.
A compass direction between north and east is:
North-east lies halfway between north and east.
structured: Give three reasons why communities should protect forests.
Forests conserve biodiversity; protect water catchments; reduce soil erosion; absorb carbon dioxide; provide sustainable resources and livelihoods.
State two responsibilities of a responsible citizen and explain one.
Obey laws, respect others' rights, pay lawful taxes, protect public property, participate peacefully in community affairs. Explain one responsibility with an example.
